## Hello! I’m Lewis.

I’m a mixed-methods researcher and data analyst working across environmental data science, public health, and UX research. I use quantitative and qualitative methods to investigate complex questions, understand human behavior, and translate evidence into useful insights for policy, programs, products, and practice.

My work has explored topics including climate and environmental health, mental health, household energy, technology adoption, and user experience. I’m especially interested in research that connects data analysis with clear communication and real world decision making.
